local proposal bundles can be exported for later governed review without requesting canonical, relationship, compatibility, runtime or mechanics mutation
projection identity changes clear local amendment drafts so proposals cannot silently cross source-package boundaries

current candidate projection is never mutated by proposal creation/edit/removal
